title: Te lo agradezco
desc: Thanking somebody so that it counts
setting: Don Beto sat up two nights in the corridor with you and has never mentioned it since.

steps.speaker: Don Beto
steps.en: And how did the boy come out?

options.es: Bien, don Beto. Gracias a Dios y gracias a usted.
options.en: Well, don Beto. Thank God and thank you.
options.feedback: The two thanks in the order they are said here, and yours is the second one on purpose.

options.en: He came out fine, thank you.
options.feedback: True and pleasant. It thanks him for asking rather than for the two nights.
Turning it back so fast is a way of not saying it at all.

steps.speaker: Don Beto
steps.es: Qué bueno. Eso era lo que había que saber.
steps.en: That is good. That was the thing that needed knowing.

options.es: Usted estuvo dos noches ahí conmigo. Eso no se me olvida.
options.en: You were there two nights with me. I will not forget that.
options.feedback: Named the thing plainly. Around here that is said once, out loud, and then never again.

options.en: I am grateful for the hospital business.
options.feedback: The right idea, wrapped in a phrase. Say what he actually did.

options.en: Sorry for bothering you so much.
options.feedback: Apologising for it takes the gift back off him.

steps.speaker: Don Beto
steps.es: Ideay, no diga nada. Uno hace lo que tiene que hacer.
steps.en: Ideay, do not say anything. One does what one has to do.

options.es: Igual se lo digo, don Beto.
options.en: I am telling you anyway, don Beto.
options.feedback: He deflected, as he had to, and you said it anyway once. That is the correct number of times.
You let him wave it away. He will assume it did not weigh much.

options.en: Yes, anybody would have done it.

steps.speaker: Don Beto
steps.es: Cuando le toque a usted, hágalo y ya.
steps.en: When it is your turn, do it and that is all.

options.es: Así va a ser. Se lo prometo.
options.en: That is how it will be. I promise you.
options.feedback: He turned the thanks into an instruction, which is the local exchange rate, and you accepted it.

options.en: Hopefully I will be able to.
options.feedback: Softer than the moment. He did not say ojalá when it was his turn.

options.en: I hope I do not have to.
options.feedback: True, and it dodges the one thing he asked for.
